title: Extract Function

solutions.title: One function per named intention
solutions.tradeoff: More functions to name, and the top-level function reads as a table of contents rather than as a procedure.

reviewFocus: Was the duplicated chip-time formatting removed, or merely extracted twice under two names?
Did the running pace total survive as a mutable accumulator? If so, why - and does the reason hold?
Are any `?? 0` fallbacks left in src/? Each one is a place where the filter and the formatting are still tangled.
Do the extracted names distinguish `format*` (a value to a string) from `render*` (a piece of the domain to output lines)?
Count the extracted functions. Ten is one defensible answer; four and twenty are both worth a paragraph.
